text: Update 7/3/21: I see some updates, some addressing what I mentioned below, like keeping a routine "active" but being able to set it with no schedule so you can start it whenever. This was kind of possible before, but it felt like a workaround as it wasn't intuitive. New method makes more sense from a user perspective. I unfortunately can't check on some of the other features as I've never encountered a persistent error message spam that happens in many transitions within the app (opening the app, finishing a routine, going into my scheduled routines etc...). This error also some comes with issues of scheduled routines not showing up in the scheduled space, and not being able to see them in my history. It's also caused issues with a routine crashing entirely, and having to start over. Support has been responsive though, and offered to extend my free trial until my issue was resolved. I think I have to follow up on that though. The app is still getting the job done, but these bugs are presenting quite a few annoyances. More or less this is the app I've been looking for to help with ADHD as an adult, but feel like I need more precise controls. No ability to control what kind of push notifications I get, just one on or off switch. No ability to start a one-off routine right when I need it, like maybe to track the routine I need to follow before I leave the house in order to an errand. Everything has to be scheduled. And no way to review past routine runs to check where you went over and where you might want to add time.
author: Joseph Charpentier
developer_reply: Hi Joseph, thank you for your feedback. We're aware that more customization options would be helpful for many users and we'll be working on them soon. Regarding spontaneous routines, you can start any of your routines at any given time with the green play button on your Scheduled Routines screen. Best regards -- Your Brili Team

text: Had a few quirks on my phone (the worst: seemed to occasionally lose the active routine but only halfway, with no way to return without restarting), but was really enjoying using it during the trial. text: I love the UI, very well crafted. I haven't been able to fully try the app yet but from just clicking around after downloading it I've found two things I would love to see changed. Customizing when you get notifications (eg 30 sec before the end of each task) would help. Also a pull down with time remaining would be great and a lock screen icon as well.

In that sense, the app is a life-saver. It's like having someone take you by the hand (in a kind way) to make sure you move along your morning tasks without getting sidetracked. Now they only need some kind of add-on that makes someone come knocking on my door if I forget to start a routine or oversleep... :D
